activity-recovery-busy: Enye inkqubo isingatha esi saziso. Hlaziya uze uzame kwakhona.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Urhoxisa ngokusisigxina ukuhanjiswa okuseleyo kwalo msebenzi? Oku akunakuphinda kuqhutyekwe nako. Imeyile esele ibekwe emgceni nezaziso esele zihanjisiwe azibuyiswa.
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Rhoxisa zonke izaziso ezisalindileyo zemisebenzi emidala kuneentsuku ezingaphi?
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Esi saziso sitshintshile ukususela ekulayishweni kwaso. Phonononga imeko ehlaziyiweyo ngaphambi kokuzama kwakhona.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Akukwazekanga ukuqinisekisa isetingi yokuhanjiswa. Hlaziya uze uphonononge imeko yayo yangoku.
activity-recovery-denied: Imvume yomamkeli okanye ukhetho lwezaziso alusakuvumeli ukuhanjiswa.
activity-recovery-description: Izaziso ezingagqitywanga zizanywa kwakhona ngokuzenzekelayo. Phonononga imisebenzi engekhoyo okanye etshintshiweyo ngaphambi kokuzama kwakhona. Ukuzama kwakhona akuze kudale umsebenzi kwakhona.
activity-recovery-failed: Akukwazekanga ukugqiba ukuhanjiswa kwezaziso. Umsebenzi osalindileyo ugciniwe.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Umsebenzi wokuqala awukho okanye utshintshile. Akukho nto idalwe kwakhona.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Hluza imihla yamakhadi usebenzisa @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt okanye @listEnteredAt. Umzekelo: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' okanye @endAt = none. Faka igama lendawo eyenzelwe wena eqala ngo-@ phakathi kweempawu zocaphulo.
advanced-filter-description: Isihluzi esikwinqanaba eliphambili livumela ukubhala umtya oqulathe abaqhubi abalandelayo: == != <= >= && || () Isithuba sisetyenziswa njengomahluli phakathi kwabaSebenzisi. Unokuzihluza zonke iiNdawo eziSiko ngokuchwetheza amagama kunye namaxabiso azo. Umzekelo: Ummandla1 == Ixabiso1. Qaphela: Ukuba amasimi okanye amaxabiso aqulathe izithuba, kufuneka uwahlanganisele kucatshulo olunye. Umzekelo: 'Ummandla 1' == 'Ixabiso loku-1'. Ukufumana abasebenzi bolawulo olunye (' \/) ukuba batsibe, ungasebenzisa \. Umzekelo: Indawo1 == Ndim. Kwakhona unokudibanisa iimeko ezininzi. Umzekelo: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngokwesiqhelo bonke abasebenzi batolikwa ukusuka ekhohlo ukuya ekunene. Unokutshintsha iodolo ngokubeka izibiyeli. Umzekelo: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3). Kananjalo unokukhangela iindawo ezibhaliweyo usebenzisa i-regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
avatars-upload-blocked-description: Thintela abasebenzisi ekulayisheni ii-avatars ezintsha (iluncedo xa ii-avatars zivunyelaniswa nomnye umthombo). Ii-avatars zivuliwe ngokumiselweyo.
board-status-remaining-time-total: Ixesha eliseleyo ukuya kufikelela kumhla wokugqibela
card-archive-pop: Ikhadi aliyi kubonakala kolu luhlu emva kokugcinwa kwekhadi.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: I-Cloud Panel yeyi-SuperAdmin kuphela, kwidomeyini ye-Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Nge-WeKan ku-Weddy, i-Cloud Panel inika iidomeyini ezininzi ze-WeKan ukusuka kwiseva enye, nganye inedatha yayo. Kwidomeyini ye-Cloud Panel, i-SuperAdmin ilawula iidomeyini kunye ne-CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ngesitshixo se-CloudFlare API, idomeyini enendawo ekwi-akhawunti yakho ye-CloudFlare ifumana irekhodi ye-DNS edluliselweyo kunye nesatifikethi se-CloudFlare Origin. Ezinye iidomeyini zifumana isatifikethi se-Let's Encrypt. Isitshixo sigcinwa kwiseva kwaye asisoze siboniswe kwakhona.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Akukho sitshixo se-CloudFlare API sigciniweyo: yonke idomeyini ifumana isatifikethi se-Let's Encrypt.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Ezinye iikholamu eziza kungeniswa njengemimandla elungiselelweyo yombhalo:
csv-mapping-description: Khetha ikholamu yefayile enommandla ngamnye wekhadi. Ukhetho lwenziwe ngokwamagama eekholamu; lungisa olungachanekanga, uze ukhethe (ayikho kwifayile) kummandla ongekhoyo kwifayile.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Ifayile ayinayo ikholamu yoluhlu. Khetha enye apha ngasentla, okanye uchwetheze igama loluhlu olunye aza kufakwa kulo onke amakhadi.
csv-mapping-list-required: Chwetheza igama loluhlu aza kufakwa kulo onke amakhadi, okanye ukhethe ikholamu enoluhlu.
delete-all-notifications-confirm: Uqinisekile ufuna ukucima zonke izaziso? Esi senzo asinakuphinda singenziwa.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Ukuhanjiswa akukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa; phonononga phambi kokuzama kwakhona

email-recovery-busy: Ukuthumela okanye omnye umsebenzi womgca uyaqhubeka. Hlaziya uze uzame kwakhona emva komzuzwana.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Rhoxisa yonke imiyalezo esemgceni ngoku yalo mamkeli? Umxholo wayo uza kucinywa kwaye awunakubuyiselwa. Imiyalezo emitsha eyenziwe emva kwesi sicelo iya kugcinwa.
email-recovery-description: Umgca omnye ngomamkeli ngamnye. Khangela nge-ID yomsebenzisi. Umxholo womyalezo namacandelo e-imeyile omamkeli awaboniswa. Ukunqumama kubamba imiyalezo ekhoyo nezayo; Ukuqhubeka kuzama kwakhona ukuthumela imiyalezo esemgceni ngoku. Ukurhoxisa kususa imiyalezo efakwe emgceni ukuya kwixesha lesicelo. Ukuba ukuthumela kuxakekile, zama kwakhona emva komzuzwana. Umyalezo osele uqalisile ukuthunyelwa awunakubuyiswa, kwaye ukuthumela okunesiphumo esingaqinisekanga kunokuphindwa. Ukusilela okusisigxina nemiyalezo efikelele kumda wokuzama kwakhona kuhlala kukhona ukuze kuhlolwe. Ukuzama kwakhona imiyalezo engaphumelelanga kuqalisa umjikelo omtsha wemizamo kwaye kugcina ukunqumama okukhoyo.
email-recovery-empty: Akukho miyalezo emgceni kwaye akukho bamkeli kunqunyanyiswe ukuthumela kubo.
email-recovery-failed: Umsebenzi awukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Hlaziya umgca uze uzame kwakhona isenzo esifanayo ukuba kuyimfuneko.
email-recovery-superseded: Isenzo esitsha somsebenzisi olawulayo sithathe indawo yesi sicelo. Kuboniswa imeko yangoku yomgca.
email-recovery-unavailable: Akukwazeki ukufunda umgca wee-imeyile. Jonga amalungelo omlawuli nokufumaneka kweseva.
